action_summary: Kept the inference-only pipeline and the frozen Xception_750 model, but replaced the single predict call with 4-view flip test-time augmentation (identity, horizontal flip, vertical flip, both), averaging the sigmoid outputs. This matches the random flips used during training, so each view is in-distribution, and averaging reduces prediction variance which typically raises per-label AUC. Added a shape assertion and clipping before writing submission.csv. Commented out the activation-visualization predict pass to save runtime for the extra TTA passes. Decoder preprocessing, paths and file format are unchanged.
